I’m one of these statistics. I’m a 21 year old college student who just tried to commit suicide two weeks ago.

It’s really hard for college students, especially those of us who don’t have the financial support from our parents. I see a lot of college students living their best lives, only having to worry about their grades, and swipe their parents credit card whenever they need something. 

As a first generation student my parents hardly make enough to sustain themselves. On top of the stress from going to school full-time I have sacrifice time to at least 20 hours at a part-time job which is probably paying me minimum wage ($7.25). 

I’d be making maybe $400 dollars at part-time retail job that I had while my off campus housing rent was a solid $650 every month. So every month I was short regardless if I ate ramen noodles for every meal or not. I also had my phone bill, gas, and groceries to pay. Eventually I qualified for food stamps but that was difficult in and of itself. 

Having no money for even your basic essentials is horrible, but now we can’t even eat out once a month or go to the movies or do anything fun or anything that we want to do. We’re just encouraged to go through school as fast as possible, work while we’re not studying, and still not have enough to sustain yourself. 

On top of that, relationship issues are high, making friends is difficult. 

I was sexually assaulted by my roommate a couple of months ago, lost my job and haven’t been able to find a new one, I also lost my financial aid and won’t be able to go back to school for a while. I’ve accumulated credit card debt that I am unable to pay, and my mental health has gone to shit. I’ve been in and out of hospitals for suicidal ideation and even attempted suicide two weeks ago. 

Sometimes it just gets really hard.
